status.block_count_note: Block count is taken from configuration. GAP-019 is unresolved: the electrical design basis states 365 MVPS while the IDT GTP BOQ lists 286+2 units. The figure shown is not a confirmed plant configuration.
status.layout_note: Equipment is assigned to contiguous zones for presentation, split to reproduce the design-basis plant DC/AC ratio. The per-station vendor mix is unknown (GAP-001); this is not an as-built layout.
status.model_note: Representative 3D model, purpose-built for this proof of concept. Geometry and part names are illustrative and do not depict the specified equipment. Architecture only.

fault_catalogue.label: Inverter trip
fault_catalogue.description: Inverter offline; the station loses that conversion path.

fault_catalogue.label: MPPT underperformance
fault_catalogue.description: Inverter tracking away from the maximum power point.

fault_catalogue.label: IDT over-temperature
fault_catalogue.description: Transformer winding temperature above its alarm setting.

fault_catalogue.label: RMU communication loss
fault_catalogue.description: Ring main unit not reporting to the station controller.

fault_catalogue.label: String outage
fault_catalogue.description: One or more strings disconnected from the combiner.
